phrases.latin: Flūmen est, Tagus, quem ex trāmine vīdistī; hīc aestuārium efficit lātissimum.
phrases.english: It’s a river, the Tagus, which you saw from the train; here it forms a very wide estuary.
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 203, 310.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
